svg.title: The same speaker says "seven" twice: never the same length, never the same timing
svg.desc: Two waveforms of the word seven spoken by the same person, on a shared time axis, with the stretch of speech found by the endpoint detector shaded. One take lasts 0.43 seconds; the other starts later, is spoken faster and lasts 0.32 seconds.
svg.text: The same speaker says "seven" twice: never the same length, never the same timing
